text: At this time the model did not identify any single change that would automatically turn the decision around. That means there isn’t a guaranteed shortcut, but you can still work on the factors that lenders usually consider. Try to lower any outstanding balances on credit cards or loans, because a smaller debt load shows you have more breathing room. If possible, increase your regular income—through a raise, a second job, or freelance work—to improve the ratio of earnings to obligations. Adding a reliable co‑signer or a joint applicant with a strong record can also make the overall application look less risky. Finally, keep existing accounts open and use them responsibly, as a longer, stable history is viewed positively. These steps won’t guarantee an immediate change, but they are the most common ways to strengthen a credit‑risk profile over time.
